dedupe_keys.name: detect waste litter detection and classification

description: Detect Waste is the Waste Detection in Pomerania team's Python software for detecting and classifying litter in photographs and video. It provides image and annotation preparation, EfficientDet detection, EfficientNet classification and alternative model workflows, with prediction scripts that draw labelled bounding boxes. Inputs are images, annotations and training settings; outputs are trained detectors, class predictions and evaluation measures. Coverage follows the image collection, not a fixed geographic survey. Public code is free under MIT, while the combined external datasets retain separate terms. A limitation is uneven documentation: some architectures remain work in progress, and experiment-tracking examples reference a private Neptune workspace that users must replace or disable. The software can prepare observations for waste-collection and sorting simulations, complementing SwolfPy (model-swolfpy). Its 2022 Waste Management paper reports benchmark experiments, not guaranteed field performance. The separately catalogued TACO and TrashNet datasets do not cover this training and inference toolkit. No photographs, model weights or external tracking service were accessed.
